full_prompt_en: A handmade scrapbook page centers a rectangular black-and-white photograph of a young woman with her hair gathered back. She looks toward the viewer with a slight relaxed smile. The photo sits slightly right of center on a large off-white paper sheet, with a pale pink wash spreading across the upper left and partly behind the image. Its edges are framed by thin translucent strips, tiny printed scraps, and rubbed pigment rather than a rigid border. Along the lower edge, a band of layered paper and washi-like tape stretches horizontally, with small red handwritten marks and fragments of faded type. At the lower right, dimensional coral-pink paper flowers, cream blossoms, pale blue leaves, and a few yellow buds cluster over the corner of the photo. A smaller cream-yellow floral group balances them at the lower left. The rest of the page remains spacious and white, though subtle gray smudges, mint stains, scuffs, and tiny black specks make it visibly worked by hand. The photograph is the clearest and sharpest component; the surrounding paper layers vary from crisp cut edges to torn, translucent, or softly rubbed shapes. Light is even and diffuse, revealing the slight raised shadows beneath flower petals and pasted pieces without turning the page into a dramatic scene. Coral and blush occupy moderate but not dominant areas; cream, gray, and off-white make the broad base. The arrangement feels personal and carefully assembled, using a small sentimental image as the anchor for tactile ornament and quiet, airy negative space.
full_prompt_zh: 一张手工剪贴簿页面以一幅长方形黑白照片为中心，照片中年轻女子将头发收起，带轻松微笑望向观者。照片位于大幅灰白纸张中央偏右，淡粉洗色从左上铺开，并部分延伸到图后。图缘由薄半透明纸条、小印刷碎片与擦抹颜料围住，而非僵硬边框。沿下缘，一条层叠纸和纸胶带般带子水平延伸，带红色细小手写痕与褪色字片段。右下方，立体珊瑚粉纸花、奶油花、淡蓝叶和几粒黄花苞聚在照片角上。左下较小奶油黄花群予以平衡。页面其余部分保持宽敞白色，但微妙灰抹痕、薄荷色污点、擦痕和小黑点使经手加工清晰可见。照片是最清晰锐利部分；周围纸层从干净裁边，到撕裂、半透明或柔和擦开的形状不一。光均匀漫射，显出花瓣和粘贴片下轻微浮起阴影，而不把页面变成戏剧场景。珊瑚和淡粉占中等而非主导面积；奶油、灰与灰白构成宽阔底色。布局私人化且精心组装，用小幅情感照片锚住可触装饰与安静透气留白。
style_prompt_en: Handmade scrapbook collage combines a crisp monochrome rectangular focal insert with broad off-white paper, translucent layered strips, and dimensional floral cutouts. Pale blush and coral washes gather mostly along one side, balanced by tiny yellow, mint, blue-gray, and black accents. Some edges are cleanly cut, others torn, rubbed, or feathered; faint scuffs, faded type fragments, small specks, and visible paper fibers prevent a flat digital finish. Thin horizontal tape-like bands support the lower edge of the main rectangle, while raised clustered forms create small local shadows. Overall light is soft and even, letting the relief of overlapping pieces supply depth. Large quiet white intervals keep the numerous tactile details airy. The composition feels asymmetrical but balanced through a larger ornament cluster on one side and a smaller answering group on the other, with a gentle nostalgic rhythm.
style_prompt_zh: 手工剪贴簿拼贴将清晰单色矩形焦点嵌片、宽阔灰白纸面、半透明叠层纸带与立体花形裁片组合。淡粉和珊瑚洗色主要聚在一侧，由微小黄、薄荷、蓝灰与黑重点平衡。有些边干净裁出，有些撕裂、擦开或羽化；淡磨痕、褪色字片、小斑点及可见纸纤维避免平板数字饰面。细水平胶带般色带支撑主要矩形下缘，浮起簇形产生局部小影。整体光柔和均匀，让叠贴片的浮雕感提供深度。大块安静白色间隔让众多可触细节仍显透气。构图不对称却平衡：一侧较大装饰簇由另一侧较小群组回应，形成温柔怀旧节奏。
theme_en: A black-and-white keepsake photograph framed by pastel paper, flowers, and layered scraps
theme_zh: 黑白留念照片嵌在粉彩纸面、花朵与叠贴碎片之中
name: Heidi Swapp
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
